Szosa Bianchi Infinito, zimą trenażer w: Bianchi Infinito road bike, in winter a trainer in ERG mode.

Dwa dni jakościowe: interwały progowe w: Two quality days: threshold intervals on Wednesday, sweet spot on Friday. This is where FTP grows.
Interwały 3-minutowe przy obniżonej obję: 3-minute intervals at reduced volume. Raises the ceiling under which your threshold sits.

Powrót do pracy progowej przy wyższym FT: Back to threshold work at a higher FTP, with the program's biggest volume.

Równe tempo w Z2, możesz rozmawiać pełny: Steady pace in Z2, you can talk in full sentences. Cadence 85–95. No stopping in the cold.
Płaska, prosta trasa bez świateł, zawsze: Flat, straight route without traffic lights, always the same one. The most common mistake: going out too hard – deliberately ride the first 5 min slower than you want to. FTP = 95% of average power. Threshold heart rate = 0.97 × average HR over the full 20 min.
Z2 z wstawkami sweet spot 2×10 min: Z2 with sweet spot efforts 2×10 min
Spokojne Z2 z dwiema wstawkami sweet spo: Easy Z2 with two 10 min sweet spot efforts (88–94% of FTP) and 5 min easy between them. Ride the efforts evenly, without surging at the start; the rest of the ride genuinely in Z2 – not “almost tempo”. If you're tired after Wednesday, do just one effort.
Tydzień pomiarowy: w niedzielę test FTP: Assessment week: 20 min FTP test on Sunday, before it only an easy spin on Friday. All power and heart-rate zones are calculated from its result. The actual plan starts on Monday 28.09.
Start bloku bazowego. Długa w poniedział: Start of the base block. The long ride on Monday should be boring – full-sentence conversation. The only day you're allowed to get tired is Wednesday.
Tydzień lżejszy: żadnych interwałów, pią: Lighter week: no intervals, Friday off. Your legs should come out fresher than they went in.
Od tego tygodnia dwa dni jakościowe: śro: From this week two quality days: a harder Wednesday, a shorter sweet spot block on Friday.
Największy tydzień fazy bazowej: ponad 4: The biggest week of the base phase: over 4 hours on Monday and an hour of sweet spot work on Wednesday.
Drugi test FTP. Jeśli wzrósł, strefy prz: Second FTP test. If it went up, the zones recalculate automatically – you'll ride the next 10 weeks on the new watts.
Blok progowy. Interwały w środę jadą na: Threshold block. Wednesday intervals are at 95–100% of FTP – ride the first two minutes by feel, heart rate catches up with a delay. In winter everything moves to the trainer.
Ostatni tydzień bloku progowego – dwa ra: Last week of the threshold block – two times 20 minutes at threshold is the hardest session of the program so far.
Test FTP po bloku progowym. Tu spodziewa: FTP test after the threshold block. This is where I expect the biggest single jump of the whole program.
Blok VO2max: objętość w dół, intensywnoś: VO2max block: volume down, intensity up. Ride the 3-minute intervals evenly (RPE 9), not as a sprint at the start. The ERG trainer is an advantage here – it holds the power for you.
Po bloku VO2max rozładowanie jest obowią: After the VO2max block the recovery week is mandatory, not optional.
Test po bloku VO2max. Nawet jeśli FTP dr: Test after the VO2max block. Even if FTP moves less than after phase II, the raised ceiling will pay off in the next phase.
Największa objętość programu i praca pro: The program's biggest volume and threshold work at the new FTP. It's spring, so long rides move back outdoors.
Szczyt objętości: ponad 4 godziny w poni: Peak volume: over 4 hours on Monday, two quality days and 1.5 h on Saturday.

Od teraz wszystko idzie w świeżość na te: From now on everything goes into freshness for the test.

Teaches you to hold tempo on tired legs – just like in the third hour of a long ride. Eat from minute 45, 60–80 g carbohydrate/h; a gel or bar before the tempo block.
Tempo: równo w Z3 (RPE 5–6, tętno 90–93: Tempo: steady in Z3 (RPE 5–6, heart rate 90–93% of LTHR) – harder than Z2, clearly easier than sweet spot; you can talk in short sentences. Flat or slightly into the wind, no stops at junctions. The second quality day of the week: don't add to the sweet spot.

We're looking for your ceiling, so we back off only on an objective signal: resting heart rate +7 bpm above average two days in a row, legs ≤ 2 two days in a row, Z2 Pw:HR more than 5% lower, sweet spot power not reaching the range, illness. Then 3–4 days of Z1 or rest and back to the plan. Key days and the long ride – no deficit.

Najmocniejszy tydzień bloku: sweet spot: The hardest week of the block: sweet spot 3×20. If power won't reach the range in the second interval at RPE 7, stop the session and ride Z2 – that's a signal, not a failure. From next week, easing off before the test.
Wygaszenie przed testem 3.12: objętość o: Easing off before the 3.12 test: volume about 40% lower, a short 2×12 sweet spot opener on Tuesday, no key sessions from Wednesday. Before winter: full SKS Bluemels 45 mudguards, clothing (merino, lobster gloves, overshoes), tyre pressure −0.3 bar.
